    Maps between block modules with the same positions #

    C.withG V' g' is the block quiver with the positions and moves of C and blocks V' with isomorphisms g'. A linear map e : V → V' intertwining g and g' gives a module map withG_hom acting blockwise; an intertwining equivalence gives an isomorphism (withG_equiv).
